visualMaster.rule: Do not infer page-specific geometry, module bundling or styling from prose. Review the actual user-provided page image and complete both visual-review passes before locking.

requiredAfterVisualReview: constraintLevel and tolerance per major object
friend-photo masks, face-safe zones and replaceability
assetDecompositionPlan only after representative ecology gate

passBChecks: all friend photo slots and hidden frame dependencies
SHOGO FRIENDS vs SHIORI FRIENDS side/role fidelity
which fixed heading/badge/icon groups are one display module
whether any photo proxy contains page decoration
reviewProcess.lockCondition: Do not set VISUAL_MASTER_LOCKED until both passes are complete and all findings plus display-module/proxy classifications are corrected in this manifest.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Classify fixed short headings, FRIENDS labels, badges, page labels and decorative short text that visually belong with their backgrounds/icons as bundled generated display modules. Visible fixed text need not remain editable. Never bake guest/friend names or any variable personal copy unless explicitly approved and intentionally fixed.

photoPolicy.expectedRole: Friends memories only; verify Visual Master photo count before lock while preserving independently replaceable friend-photo slots.
photoPolicy.rule: Every friend photo slot must be a separate clipped/masked replaceable image. Use clean standalone group/friend photos only; no P05 page title, frame, sticker, border, flower, caption or background may be baked into the proxy. Face/eye safety overrides TARGET geometry.

systemicPreproductionGates.purpleDriftRule: #7e08f9 and nearby saturated purple must not become a dominant fill/route/background color without owner approval
systemicPreproductionGates.rule: Inherited from preproduction-page-gates-manifest.json; page-specific details still require direct P05 Visual Master review before production.

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P05.png used as friend-photo fill
page screenshot used as friend-photo proxy
same decorated proxy duplicated across multiple friend slots
generic equal-card componentization solely for convenience
watercolor/painterly/vintage escape from V30 graphic family
binary alpha accepted solely because outside transparency is real
fixed display module flattening a replaceable friend photo

qa.gate0: Pending direct visual review of actual page master plus second-pass reverse omission audit.
